rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
rows.label: Official test: employee (lavoro subordinato)
rows.value: Civil code art. 2094: a person who works for pay 'alle dipendenze e sotto la direzione dell'imprenditore' (under the employer's direction) is an employee
rows.note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
rows.source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
rows.label: Official test: self-employed (contratto d'opera)
rows.value: Civil code art. 2222: a person who undertakes a work or service for a fee, mainly with their own labour and without subordination to the client
rows.note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
rows.source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
rows.label: Collaborations organised by the client (collaborazioni etero-organizzate)
rows.value: Mainly personal, continuous work whose way of working is organised by the client, including through digital platforms, is treated as employment from 1 January 2016 (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2(1)); exceptions for collective agreements, registered professions, company officers and some others
rows.note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
rows.source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Corporate income tax (IRES) [national]
rows.value: 24% (+3.5 points for banks and financial intermediaries); 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of €750,000,000 or more. Paid by companies and entities resident in Italy, and non-resident companies on their Italian income. TUIR (DPR 917/1986) art. 77; D.Lgs. 209/2023 Titolo II.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Normattiva: TUIR (DPR 917/1986), art. 77 (text in force on 14 November 2026); Agenzia delle Entrate: Corporate income tax (IRES) (latest update 24/12/2024)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Regional business tax on productive activities (IRAP) [regional]
rows.value: 3.9% standard rate; regions may raise it by up to 0.92 percentage points or cut it, down to zero (code 001 rates in 2026: 2.68% to 4.97%). Paid by companies, partnerships and public bodies (not resident individuals in business or a profession). D.Lgs. 446/1997 art. 16. In force from 1 January 2026.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: MEF Dipartimento delle Finanze: IRAP, Disciplina del tributo (aliquote 2026); D.Lgs. 446/1997 art. 16; L. 199/2025 art. 1(74); D.L. 21/2026 art. 3

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: branches pay IRES and IRAP on attributable profits, with no separate tax on remittances found; 26% withholding on dividends to non-residents (1.2% for listed EU and EEA companies). Paid by non-resident companies with an Italian branch; non-resident shareholders (withheld by the company). TUIR art. 152; DPR 600/1973 art. 27; D.L. 66/2014 art. 3. In force from 1 July 2014.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Normattiva: DPR 600/1973, art. 27 (ritenuta sui dividendi) and art. 27-bis (text in force on 14 November 2026); D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3(1)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (INPS) [national]
rows.value: Gestione Separata 26.07% for professionals without their own fund; artigiani 24%, commercianti 24.48% on income from €18,808 (+1 point above €56,224). Paid by self-employed people, professionals without their own fund, craftspeople and traders. L. 335/1995 art. 2(26); L. 233/1990. In force from 1 January 2026.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Contractor rules: employment status and withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: civil code arts. 2094 and 2222 test; collaborations organised by the client treated as employment; 20% withholding on fees to residents, 30% to non-residents. Paid by clients and businesses paying self-employed people (withholding agents). Civil code arts. 2094 and 2222; D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2; DPR 600/1973 arts. 25 and 25-bis.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Simplified regimes: regime forfettario and simplified accounting [national]
rows.value: 15% substitute tax (5% for new activities) up to €85,000 of revenue; simplified accounting up to €500,000 (services) or €800,000 (other activities). Paid by sole traders and freelancers who qualify. L. 190/2014 art. 1(54)-(89); DPR 600/1973 art. 18.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Regime forfetario - Che cos'è (last updated 21 July 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: normal IRPEF scale on pay for work done in Italy, withheld by the employer; no family tax credits unless 75% of income is Italian. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). TUIR arts. 2, 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Property tax: IMU (imposta municipale propria) [municipal]
rows.value: 0.86% base rate, comuni set 0% to 1.06% (luxury main homes 0.5% with a €200 deduction); main homes exempt; IMIS in Trento, IMI in Bolzano, ILIA in Friuli Venezia Giulia. Paid by owners of buildings and land. L. 160/2019 art. 1(738)-(783). In force from 1 January 2020.

rows.label: Property transfer tax: registration, mortgage and cadastral taxes [national]
rows.value: registration tax 9%, or 2% on a main home (minimum €1,000), plus €50 + €50; new homes from builders pay VAT at 4%, 10% or 22% plus €200 for each of the three fixed taxes. Paid by the buyer. DPR 131/1986 Tariffa parte prima art. 1; D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 10; DPR 633/1972 tabella A. In force from 1 January 2014.
